sources.title: mario-rc/multi-domain-rm-mistral-7b-it · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a multi-domain reward model built from weqweasdas/RM-Mistral-7B. It combines 23 fine-grained regression objectives across coherence, commonsense, empathy, and multicultural response quality with a prompt-conditioned gating network that produces a single preference score.

sources.title: GitHub - Mario-RC/multi-domain-reward-model · GitHub
sources.snippet: The model learns 23 fine-grained attributes spanning these domains and combines them through a prompt-conditioned gating network to produce a single preference score, enabling reward evaluation that captures domain-specific nuances.
